title: I will build n8n automations to connect your tools
description:
I build n8n automations that connect the tools you already use, so repetitive work runs without you.

What you get:
- A working workflow built and tested on your data
- Error handling and retry logic so it does not fail silently
- A short written guide so your team can maintain it
- Optional AI step (classify, summarise, draft) inside the flow

How it works: you describe the manual process, I map it, build it, and walk you through a test run before delivery.

Not sure which package fits? Message me here with your tools and the task, and I will recommend one before you order.

faq.a: Anything with an API or a webhook. If n8n has a node for it, it is quick; if not, I use the HTTP request node.

faq.q: Do I need my own n8n server?
faq.a: No. I can build on n8n Cloud or on your self-hosted instance. Tell me which you use in the order requirements.

faq.q: What if the workflow breaks later?
faq.a: Revisions cover fixes to what I built within the package limits. Bigger changes can be a new order.

requirements: Please describe the manual process you want automated, step by step.
Which apps are involved, and do you use n8n Cloud or self-hosted?
Please share example data (with private details removed).
